studies.population: Three women, nine men from varied backgrounds, mainly people who requested beta access.

response_sets.condition: top ten from two combined interests

tasks: Rate top-ten results of two composite-interest lists for relevance and unexpectedness, then judge three explanation features.
studies.results: 61.6% results rated relevant/strongly relevant, 65% unexpected/strongly unexpected, 35.42% both. Explanation-ranking percentages use a denominator apparently 11, despite survey n=12.
limitations: Participant/response denominators for explanation ranking must not be equated automatically.
studies.design: Discovery Hub composite-interest survey; No alternative-system comparator; each judges two lists from two randomly combined Facebook likes.
